config.retention: journal 1d, idempotency 1d (server defaults); Agent K/V state never expires
config.retry_policy: server default per docs: 50ms initial, factor 2, max 60s, 70 attempts, then pause; ctx.run default (no per-run policy)
config.durability: single node, bifrost replicated loglet with replication 1, log-server rocksdb-disable-wal-fsync=false (default)
config.t_f_token: sys_invocation.last_start_at (ms) of the attempt that sends T-F
config.owner_timeout: the engine's own retry: the owner is asked when T-N runs in an attempt after its journalled Run command
